news.title: Investor sentiment deteriorates as stock falls 15%
news.body: After last week's 15% share price decline to ₹121, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 30.2x. Average trailing P/E is 23x in the Software industry in India. Total loss to shareholders of 70% over the past year.

news.title: Chairman of the Board & MD recently bought ₹6.6m worth of stock
news.body: On the 19th of March, Milind Padole bought around 45k shares on-market at roughly ₹148 per share. This transaction amounted to 1.4% of their direct individual holding at the time of the trade. This was the largest purchase by an insider in the last 3 months. Despite this recent buy, Milind has been a net seller over the last 12 months, reducing personal holdings by ₹49m.

news.title: Affordable Robotic & Automation Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 150.000072 million in funding from Atri Energy Transition Private Limited
news.body: Affordable Robotic & Automation Limited has entered into Term Sheet for issuance of 604,839 equity share at a price of INR 248 for gross proceeds of INR 150,000,072 on February 18, 2026. Transaction will involve participation of ATRI Energy Transition Private Limited. Transaction is approval by board of directors and is still subject to shareholder approval and execution of definitive documentations. Post allotment investor will have 604,839 shares for 5.10% stake.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.4% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (2.7x net interest cover). news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.16 (vs ₹12.40 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.16 (up from ₹12.40 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹199.5m (down 75% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹13.1m (up ₹152.5m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 6.6% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). The move to profitability was driven by lower expenses.

news.title: Affordable Robotic & Automation Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 150.000072 million in funding from Sai Green Mobility Private Limited
news.body: Affordable Robotic & Automation Limited has entered into Term Sheet/Memorandum of Understanding for issuance of 604,839 at a price of INR 248 per share for gross proceeds of INR 150,000,072 on February 12, 2026. The securities will be issued on preferential basis. The transaction has been approved by the board of directors of the company. The proposed investment is subject to satisfactory due diligence, board approval, shareholder approval and execution of definitive documentations.

news.title: Affordable Robotic & Automation Limited to Report Q3, 2026 Results on Feb 11, 2026
news.body: Affordable Robotic & Automation Limited announced that they will report Q3, 2026 results at 12:15 PM, Indian Standard Time on Feb 11, 2026
